qualification: local A05.3 reliability isolation; not A05.3 closure, performance acceptance, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

candidate.acceptedBoundary: The experimental production PC machine exposed only the generated indirect-branch target cache. Both direct-source classes and the shadow-return stack were disabled.
candidate.behavioralIntent: Test generated IBTC reliability independently from direct chaining and shadow-return prediction after raw host-target prediction was identified as a reliability boundary.
candidate.productionFinding: Two runs of the exact same hashed release runner passed all seven authenticated workloads and powered off. Both exercised IBTC fills and hits while recording zero direct-chain patches and zero shadow-return activity. This accepts the IBTC as a bounded isolated reliability boundary, but its dispatcher avoidance is too small to displace the independently accepted Tier-one direct production default.

verification.focused: 38 tests in two suites passed, including an explicit IBTC-only warm-hit/invalidation regression plus predictor-boundary and PC machine coverage.
verification.deterministicAggregate: 1,558 tests in 179 suites passed with test parallelism disabled.

retainedProductionBoundary.reason: Tier-one-only direct chaining produced approximately 36.45-percent within-run avoidance, versus approximately 0.90 percent for the isolated IBTC.

disposition.reason: The IBTC-specific regression is retained, but production returns to Tier-one-only direct chaining. A05.3 remains open for shadow-return isolation, safe predictor combinations, and a final enabled path exceeding 95-percent dispatcher avoidance.

limitations: Two passing local runs are a bounded reliability check, not cross-host qualification or proof that every intermittent failure has been eliminated.
The experiment establishes isolated IBTC behavior only; it does not establish safety when combined with either direct-source class or shadow returns.
The approximately 0.90-percent within-run avoidance is below the strict A05.3 performance threshold.
The raw diagnostic receipts remain in /private/tmp; this checked-in record binds their hashes and selected counters.
